# Clyvora Convert

> Clyvora Convert is Clyvora's free, source-available, local-first image, audio, and video converter for the browser.

Selected files are processed on the user's device and are not uploaded to a Clyvora conversion server. Clyvora Convert has no accounts, cloud storage, behavioural profiling, or external conversion API. The deployed site uses anonymous, cookie-free Vercel Web Analytics for standard page views only; filenames and media contents are not included. Optional link importing contacts the source host; SoundCloud link resolution sends only the pasted URL to the configured resolver, not the media bytes.

## Supported formats

- Images: PNG, JPG/JPEG, and WebP.
- Audio: MP3, WAV, OGG, and Opus.
- Video: MP4 and WebM, including conversion to supported audio formats.

## Capabilities

- Batch conversion, per-file settings, and ZIP export.
- Image resize, quality, aspect-ratio, and transparency controls.
- Audio bitrate, channel, and sample-rate controls.
- Video quality, resolution, codec, and audio-bitrate controls.
- Offline use after the required application assets have been cached.
